WITH Sales AS ( SELECT DISTINCT TOP ${LastN} SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDER.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, SORDER.BPCNAM_0 AS CustomerName, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS QTY, SORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, SORDER.CUR_0 AS Currency, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SORDERQ.CREDAT_0 DESC, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 DESC) AS ROWNUM FROM SORDERP INNER JOIN SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 LEFT JOIN SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0 AND SORDERP.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND SORDERQ.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND SORDERP.SALFCY_0 = #{Site} AND SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 = #{Site} AND SORDER.SALFCY_0 = #{Site} ORDER BY ROWNUM ASC )
SELECT * FROM Sales WHERE Sales.ROWNUM = #{LastN}

WITH Quote AS ( SELECT DISTINCT TOP ${LastN} SQUOTED.SQHNUM_0 AS QuoteNO, SQUOTED.QUODAT_0 AS QuoteDate, SQUOTE.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, SQUOTE.BPCNAM_0 AS CustomerName, SQUOTED.QTY_0 AS QTY, SQUOTED.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, SQUOTE.CUR_0 AS Currency, SQUOTED.ORDFLG_0 AS OrderFlag, SQUOTED.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SQUOTED.CREDAT_0 DESC, SQUOTED.SQHNUM_0 DESC) AS ROWNUM FROM SQUOTE LEFT JOIN SQUOTED ON SQUOTED.SQHNUM_0=SQUOTE.SQHNUM_0 WHERE SQUOTED.NETPRI_0 > 0 AND SQUOTED.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND SQUOTED.SALFCY_0 = #{Site} AND SQUOTE.SALFCY_0 = #{Site} ORDER BY ROWNUM ASC )
SELECT * FROM Quote WHERE Quote.ROWNUM = #{LastN}

WITH T0 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT TOP ${LastN} OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 AS ProjectNO, OPPOR.ZOPPNUMORI_0 AS ProjectOriNO, OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 AS ProjectPN, OPPOR.CREDAT_0 AS ProjectDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY OPPOR.CREDAT_0 DESC) AS ROWNUM0 FROM EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR WHERE OPPOR.SALFCY_0 = #{Site} -- CDE: Order project -- ART: Stock project AND OPPOR.OPPTYP_0 IN ('CDE','ART') AND OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 = #{PnRoot} ORDER BY OPPOR.CREDAT_0 DESC ), T1 AS ( SELECT * FROM T0 WHERE T0.ROWNUM0 = #{LastN} ), T2 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T1.*, Sum(PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0) OVER (PARTITION BY PORDERP.PJT_0) AS LocalCostNoTax, Sum(PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0 + PORDERQ.AMTTAXLIN1_0 + PORDERQ.AMTTAXLIN2_0 + PORDERQ.AMTTAXLIN3_0) OVER (PARTITION BY PORDERP.PJT_0) AS LocalCostWithTax, PORDERQ.QTYPUU_0 AS Qty, PORDERQ.CPRCUR_0 AS Currency, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0 DESC) AS ROWNUM2 FROM EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ PORDERQ ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PORDERP.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN T1 ON PORDERP.PJT_0 = T1.ProjectNO OR PORDERP.PJT_0 =T1.ProjectOriNO WHERE PORDERP.PJT_0 != '' AND PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 = #{Site} AND PORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0 )
SELECT T2.ProjectNO, T2.ProjectOriNO, T2.ProjectPN, T2.ProjectDate, T2.LocalCostNoTax/T2.Qty LocalCostNoTax, T2.LocalCostWithTax/T2.Qty LocalCostWithTax, T2.Currency FROM T2 WHERE T2.ROWNUM2 = 1
